links.outcome: Safety, patient and clinician experience of AI in a limited prospective real-world pilot with real-time supervision
links.effect: Safety supervisors monitored all interactions in real time and did not need to stop any consultation; patients reported high satisfaction; PCPs found output useful.
links.quote: Human safety supervisors monitored all patient-AMIE interactions in real time and did not need to intervene to stop any consultations based on pre-defined criteria.

unlisted_practices: Real-time human safety supervisor monitoring of patient-facing LLM chat with predefined stop criteria
Using AI history-taking and differential diagnosis output as pre-visit preparation for clinicians

screen.reason: Prospective feasibility study of a conversational LLM (AMIE) deployed with 100 real urgent care patients, directly testing real-time human safety supervision and escalation monitoring alongside clinician and patient workflow evaluation.
